title: P1: Selection Center results omit stock names and waste main-table space on low-value trace column
description:
Expected: Selection Center results should reuse the existing Paper v2 simulation/trading stock-name enrichment/display logic so operators see symbol plus stock_name/symbol_name. The main results table should replace the current Trace/?? column with useful backend/API market context such as trade-date volume/volume_hand, amount when available, previous close/pre_close, and data_as_of/source, while keeping raw component_scores accessible in a secondary audit/detail view. Fresh runs, listed historical runs, get-run detail, and aggregate-existing-runs should expose the same display metadata consistently.
Actual: SelectionCandidate currently carries symbol, score, rank, target fields, reference_price, component_scores, and reason, but not stock_name/symbol_name or market snapshot fields. frontend/src/app/paper-v2/selection/page.tsx renders selected stocks as row.symbol only. Its Trace/?? column renders Object.keys(row.component_scores).join(", "), so it shows explanation key names rather than values; these keys are usually nearly identical across rows and consume primary table space without helping operators choose or inspect stocks.

runtime_paths: Paper v2 Selection UI results table
trigger_condition.user_requirement: Use the same stock-name display logic already implemented in Paper v2 simulation/trading, and replace the low-value main-table Trace/?? column with useful stock market fields such as volume and yesterday close.
trigger_condition.trace_column_current_meaning: The current Selection UI trace column renders only Object.keys(component_scores). component_scores is backend audit/explanation metadata such as source_package_ids, package_ranks, package_raw_scores, package_rank_scores, package_weights, hmm, tradability_filter, event_risk, raw_rank, or aggregation_source depending on runtime path. The UI shows only the key names, not the values, so rows often look almost identical.

reproduce_command: Open /paper-v2/selection, run or load a Selection Center run, inspect the selection results table: the stock column shows only the symbol and the Trace/?? column shows comma-separated component_scores keys that are nearly identical across rows instead of useful market fields such as stock name, volume, and previous close.
required_verification: Selection result rows display symbol plus stock name using the same resolver/field priority as Paper v2 simulation/trading views: stock_name first, symbol_name fallback, no display name means symbol-only fallback.

The SelectionCandidate API/types include display-only stock_name/symbol_name without changing ranking, score, target_weight, target_quantity, reference_price, HMM scoring, ST PIT/risk/tradability filtering, StrategyPackage contract behavior, or order generation.

Main result table replaces the Trace/?? column with useful market fields from backend/API: at minimum volume (or volume_hand with unit clearly shown) and previous close/pre_close; amount/latest close/data_as_of/source should be included if available without changing selection decisions.

Raw component_scores remain accessible in a secondary detail view for audit/debugging, and tests assert the primary table no longer renders comma-separated component_scores keys as the default trace column.
Historical run retrieval and aggregate-existing-runs paths return the same display fields as fresh runs.
Missing stock name or market snapshot data is clearly represented as display metadata unavailable; it must not fail a successful selection run or silently alter selection/reference-price semantics.

Validation record includes DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 item-by-item matrix and reports production_ddl_gate, production_frontend_dependency_gate, production_backend_dependency_gate, and whether production 8001/3000 were touched.
closure_requirements: Selection Center result UI shows stock code plus name consistently with Paper v2 simulation/trading views.
Primary result table no longer uses the wide Trace/?? column to show only component_scores key names; valuable stock market context such as volume and previous close is shown instead.
component_scores/audit trace is preserved in a secondary detail affordance and remains available for debugging and evidence.
Fresh, historical, and aggregate-existing selection result paths use one consistent display-enrichment contract.
No trading/selection decision behavior is changed by display-only name or market metadata enrichment.
non_goals: Do not change selection ranking, HMM scoring, ST PIT/risk/tradability filters, StrategyPackage contract behavior, order generation, or Paper v2 execution.
Do not introduce fallback market data that silently changes reference_price or trading decisions.
Do not remove component_scores or audit evidence; move it out of the main table only.

events.note: User reported Selection Center result UI gap: stock names missing while Paper v2 simulation displays them, and Trace/?? column is low-value repetitive component_scores key metadata.
